title: Mouse Without Borders Portable 1.0.1-rc.10
summary: Restore the keyboard-shortcut divider and a large multiline IP mappings editor, with clearer help. Keep RC9’s fast, compact settings layout.
changes: Restore the visual divider above keyboard shortcuts without adding nested layout tables.
Keep the IP mappings editor large enough for multiple computer entries, including when empty. Apply the same minimum-height protection to administrator-provided mappings.
Rewrite mapping help to explain when entries are needed, the name/address format, where to find the local IPv4 address, and how a router DHCP reservation helps. Keep the explanation visible.
Clarify DNS hover help and Installation descriptions. Preserve tooltip defaults and their existing exceptions, saved preferences, and transfer behavior.
testing: Open Other Options repeatedly: it should still open promptly, with a horizontal divider above keyboard shortcuts and no new scrolling at the usual window size.

Open IP Mappings: the empty box should show several lines. If you use mappings, confirm multiple entries remain visible when editing and after switching tabs. Do not add example addresses unless they match your PCs.
Check that the visible mapping instructions and DNS tooltip are clear. Resize the window or use your normal Windows display scaling to check the editor and text.
Confirm receiving-folder, automatic transfer-window closing, shortcuts, and Installation settings retain your choices.
known_limitations: Real Windows Explorer, physical display scaling, startup/uninstall, and two-PC behavior still need the manual checks above; automated tests cannot replace them.

Receiving-folder and automatic-close preferences belong to each PC. Changing the folder affects new durable drag/drop transfers only; existing jobs and legacy clipboard file copying keep their prior destinations.

The receiving folder must be an accessible ordinary local directory. Linked directories and unavailable drives are rejected. No overwrite/merge, protocol, concurrency, speed, service, or automatic-update behavior is added.
Use the same RC on both PCs for consistent Settings. RC6/RC7 protocol-2 transfers remain compatible; older EXEs may discard the new preference fields if they rewrite the same preferences file.
Full-speed Wi-Fi transfers can still cause mouse lag. Offline temporary data can only be cleaned when the peer reconnects.
